findings.issue: Secrets injected inline in run: command via heredoc
findings.impact: Secrets visible in CI logs if command fails or debug enabled
findings.fix: Move SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF to env: block instead of inline in run: supabase link command

findings.issue: No explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions block â€” uses default write-all
findings.impact: Deploy workflow has full write scope to all resources unnecessarily
findings.fix: Add permissions: contents: read, packages: write at top of workflow

findings.issue: No explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions block â€” uses default write-all
findings.impact: Production deploy workflow has full write scope to all resources
findings.fix: Add permissions: contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write at top of workflow

findings.issue: 16 of 20 workflows lack explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions block
findings.impact: Default permissive token scope on most workflows (write-all on contents, packages, etc.)
findings.fix: Add explicit permissions: block to each workflow with least-privilege scopes

findings.issue: ci.yml triggers on push to main/develop but no path filter on schedule
findings.impact: Scheduled runs trigger full CI stack even with no code changes
findings.fix: Add path filter to schedule trigger or use paths-ignore for docs-only changes

findings.issue: DO_API_TOKEN and other secrets used inline in run: commands via heredoc style
findings.impact: Secrets could leak in logs if curl commands fail
findings.fix: Pass DO_API_TOKEN and CF_API_TOKEN via env: block, reference as $DO_API_TOKEN in scripts

findings.issue: No explicit retention period set on test results and coverage artifacts
findings.impact: Artifacts stored indefinitely, accumulating storage costs

findings.issue: build-push.yml triggers on PR to develop and main â€” builds images on every PR even for doc-only changes
findings.impact: Unnecessary image builds consuming CI minutes
